calculation.description: A causal exhaustion reversal signal combining volatility-normalized five-day return reversal with adverse three-day close-location value. The signal is scaled by relative cross-asset dispersion to emphasize unusually dispersed regimes. Positive values forecast stronger forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: The complete panel has 15 tradable instruments and dates are evaluated cross-sectionally with at least 8 valid instruments. 2025-2026 10d IC/ICIR were 0.05433/0.17498; 2027-2028 0.04940/0.14676; recent 2028-08-01 through 2029-05-16 0.08654/0.27208. The factor is highly correlated with existing reversal artifacts and should receive limited ensemble weight.
